headline: Delivery Driver
summary: Delivery rider and driver with a year of experience delivering parcels and food around Dapitan and Dipolog. I hold a professional driver's licence for motorcycles and light vehicles, drive defensively in town traffic and treat every customer politely at the door. I have a clean driving record.

projects.name: Clean driving record
bullets: No traffic violations or accidents in over 20,000 kilometres of delivery driving.

projects.name: Defensive driving seminar
projects.description: Completed a one-day defensive driving seminar covering road rules, hazard awareness and safe motorcycle riding.

skills: Professional driver's licence (codes A and B)

experience.title: Delivery Rider
bullets: Deliver about 70 parcels a day by motorcycle in Dapitan and nearby barangays.
Collect cash-on-delivery payments and remit them at the end of each shift.
Check the motorcycle's brakes, lights and tyres before every trip.

experience.title: Food Delivery Rider
bullets: Delivered food orders in the evenings and weekends.
